_example.note: serverMessage is the FCM message built by server/controllers/controllerPush.js sendFcmNotification with the token omitted. Each variant payload shows only the fields that _notificationCallback in client/www/js/service.push.js reads from FirebasePlugin.onNotificationOpen. How the unpinned cordova-plugin-firebase places FCM data and APNs fields is outside the checkout; other plugin-added fields are omitted and unverified. clientHandling is documentation metadata. No tokens, device IDs or real notification text.
_example.titleRule: Alarm title = location prefix (pushInfo.name + ' '; KMA falls back to town/city/region names) + summary title. TodayWeather summary titles are the LOC_CURRENT hourly summary; TodayAir summary titles are always '', so this TodayAir-style title is the place name with a trailing space. Alert pushes build their own title in alert.push.controller.js.
_example.verification: 2026-09-24 Node VM run of the checked-in service.weatherinfo.js and service.push.js with stubbed injection; the recorded outcomes match clientHandling. No device, plugin or FCM delivery.

variants.name: backgroundTap
variants.clientHandling: parseInt('2') = 2 -> WeatherInfo.setCityIndex(2) -> $broadcast('reloadEvent', 'push'); an out-of-range index is rejected silently by setCityIndex but the reload is still broadcast

variants.name: apsForeground
variants.clientHandling:
title = aps.alert.title, message = aps.alert.body -> $broadcast('notificationEvent', result) -> TabCtrl popup template title + '
' + message; no reload, no city change

variants.name: nonApsForeground
variants.clientHandling: no aps -> message = body, top-level title kept -> notificationEvent popup; no reload, no city change

variants.name: invalidIndexTap
variants.clientHandling: parseInt -> NaN -> Util.ga.trackException(new Error('invalid fav:NaN')); no city change, no reload
